inputs.text: Daniel Rubenstein’s call for a political resolution matters, but it rings hollow alongside talk of Israel’s “unwavering stance” and a continuing operation. Security built around military pressure risks deepening the conditions that make people across the region unsafe. A real resolution must address the structures driving the conflict and uphold everyone’s rights—not normalize endless escalation as the only path forward.
